note: Tracks containing legs no vessel could travel. Almost always two hulls sharing one MMSI, or a corrupted fix - not GNSS spoofing, and not a cable threat. Listed so you know which tracks not to trust. Tracks assessed as MMSI collisions are excluded from behavioural detection entirely, because behaviour cannot be attributed to a hull.
